1. Wait 30 minutes for the lock to release automatically.
2. Unlock immediately at https://id.nakhla.example/unlock by entering your work email and approving the NakhlaKey prompt or using a backup code. This does not change your password.

If you forgot your password, reset it at https://id.nakhla.example/reset, which also unlocks the account.

If the lockout keeps happening, check if any device or app is still trying to sign in with an old password (mail app, mapped drives, saved credentials). Update or remove those old passwords before unlocking again.

turns.reply:
The error NX-781 means your NakhlaConnect client version is below the minimum supported version. You need to update your client to version 5.4.2 from Software Center and then restart NakhlaConnect. Since you are on macOS 14 and using version 5.2.3, this update is required because the gateways reject any client older than 5.4 since 2026-06-01.

If the update from Software Center is slow on hotel Wi-Fi, there is no documented quicker trick. You must update via Software Center as per policy. After updating, restart the client and try connecting again.

You can also switch the gateway between GW-1 and GW-2 in NakhlaConnect > Settings > Gateway, but since you are assigned to GW-1, this may not help much.
